name: Homeowner consultant mode - kitchen renovation
description: Homeowner mentions kitchen renovation. AI should switch to consultant mode: build excitement, educate about HDS (factory, 32 branches), guide step by step, recommend ONE product.

messages.text: Hi, I'm renovating my kitchen and need some boards for the cabinets. What do you suggest?

expected_behaviors.description: At least one assistant reply expected
AI should acknowledge the kitchen project
AI should NOT ask for a cutting list from a homeowner (they won't have one)
